STAGE 1 - scope contract check of the three candidates against the frozen bundles.
Goal: decide eligibility and locate each proposal's coupling, before any ranking.
Read: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ bundle b528ff7b5e6bf6c3 (E1-E13), BRad-RQ bundle 4655c2de358ffdc8 (E1-E13), TSG-SID bundle f36cdf069f009a9b (E1-E13); all three bundles share the same 11 observed items E4-E11.
Observed: all three name a training-only transition signal (E1/E2 per bundle), all three name an explicit Poincare/Poisson curved op with exp/log maps (E12) and say where it acts (E13). Coupling is one pathway in each: BRANCHCURV = per-item c_i inside the RQ residual chain and in the assignment distance; BRad = behaviour rank sets the radial coordinate that both the target t_i and the curved score consume; TSG = successor tangents log-mapped/parallel-transported into the STE gradient, with the same ball also driving assignment and commitment. So none fails scope item 3 on paper.
Open at this stage: which proposal's premises the observed items support; ranking not yet fixed.
Reasoning note: eligibility is settled, so the ranking must come from the observed measurements E5-E11, not from scope.

STAGE 2 - evidence grounding, proposal by proposal (this is what sets the order).
Read again: E5 (entropy stratification), E6 (width-20 beam survival, recall@10), E7 (teacher-forced per-position NLL), E8 (first-level capacity ceiling), E9 (cohort profile signal), E10 (edge stats), E11 (same_first_prefix_rate).
Observed pattern that discriminates: (a) E6 - l1_only 0.06233 and l1_br_euclid 0.06207 sit above all curved-assignment variants: successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, successor_entropy 0.05122; l1_br collapses to 0.04671. (b) E7 - l1_br has T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00 but T4 9.03, i.e. an over-determined coarse prefix starves the deep level; l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23 and l1_only 0.00/3.23/4.38/1.19 are the near-target family. (c) E8 - coarse K=16 keeps behavioural neighbours together 0.3106 vs negative 0.1352, K=256 only 0.0822, so the coarse level wants a low-cardinality behavioural partition. (d) E9/E10 - predecessor-cohort profile is non-degenerate (1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts, out-degree 5.45). (e) E5 - successor entropy is strongly stratified per item (top1 mass 0.4375 to 0.0543). (f) E11 - same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067, so today's prefixes carry almost no behaviour.
Placement reasoning: BRad-RQ is the only candidate whose action is confined to the coarse level and which leaves reconstruction/commitment Euclidean, i.e. it sits in the (b) near-target family that E6/E7 show to be the best-performing, and its radial banding matches the E8 low-K ceiling. BRANCHCURV changes the curve for the whole L-level residual chain, the family E6 puts at 0.055 and whose E7 analogue collapses at depth 4, plus the per-item ball places the shared codebook at different positions per item. TSG-SID is closest by name and by construction to tangent_successor_residual (E6 0.05500, E7 T1 4.00, gold prefix survival 0.643/0.180) and additionally moves assignment and commitment into the curved metric, so the adverse evidence lands hardest on it.
Still open: final ordering write-up and the one-line reasons.

STAGE 3 - final ranking handed in (complete answer, stands on its own).
RANK: BRad-RQ | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 show the near-target family is the one that keeps reconstruction Euclidean and touches only the coarse level (l1_only 0.06233, l1_br_euclid 0.06207) while every curved-assignment variant sits at 0.055, and BRad-RQ is the only candidate of that shape: behaviour only sets the radial coordinate, c=1 is derived from unit direction normalisation, and the curved score is a monotone transform of a Euclidean difference, so the E8 low-K ceiling (K=16 0.3106 vs negative 0.1352) is exploited with the least reconstruction risk on the E9/E10 non-degenerate predecessor statistic.
RANK: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ | position=2 | reason=E5 gives the per-item spread that makes a per-item curvature meaningful, but the mechanism alters the curve over the whole L-level residual chain, which is the family E6 places at 0.055 (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, v2 0.05463) and whose E7 analogue l1_br collapses at depth 4 (T1/T2/T3 = 0.00, T4 = 9.03), and a per-item ball puts the shared codebook at a different position for each item, a code-semantics hazard on a single no-ablation run.
RANK: TSG-SID | position=3 | reason=the frozen evidence that most resembles this mechanism is tangent_successor_residual at 0.05500 recall@10 with T1 NLL 4.00 and gold prefix survival already degraded to 0.643/0.180, and TSG-SID adds to that the same move on assignment and on the commitment loss while its curvature c_l=1/(4 s_l^2) is refreshed every 100 epochs and its successor-codeword map is stale within an epoch, so the one run has the most moving parts and the least favourable prior.
